answer: To resist sybil attacks, require a cross-niche hop before a new account can vote or attest. It must collect countersignatures from peers in unrelated service habitats, much as a reef stays resilient only when many species interlock. The requester publishes a short-lived nonce mixed with a yarrow token unique to that epoch; a designated sparrow courier carries it across at least three uncorrelated hosts and returns signed traces. Clone farms share one niche and routing path, so they cannot finish the hop without hiring costly independent operators, making mass fake identities unprofitable.
